recipe.title: Crispy chickpeas
recipe.notes: This is based on a few different processes I read online. I haven't tested whether all these steps are really needed for proper crispiness.
recipe.serves: Makes a good snack or adds crunch to a salad.

method.s: Drain and wash the tinned chickpeas well under cold water in a colander, using fingertips to rub off the skins and pick out (I haven't tried leaving the separated skins in yet, but that would save some hassle).
Fan bake in one layer on a lined baking tray for about an hour, until crispy.
Combine spices with oil (less is more - make it a light coating) and mix through the baked chickpeas in a bowl.
Return coated chickpeas to the oven and bake another 10 minutes to cook the spices and oil mix.
Turn the oven off but leave the fan running until cooled.
